questions.question: Which two query features are listed for Firestore?

options.A: Combining filtering and sorting
options.C: Mandatory full-dataset scans for every query
options.D: No selective retrieval of individual documents

questions.explanation: Firestore belirli dokümanları veya query'ye uyan koleksiyonu sorgulayabilir; filtre ve sıralama birleşebilir.

questions.question: According to the module, indexed query performance is proportional primarily to what?

options.A: The result-set size
options.B: The amount of unrelated source code
options.C: The size of the entire dataset
options.D: The number of projects in the organization

questions.explanation: Kaynak query performansını tüm dataset yerine sonuç kümesi büyüklüğüyle ilişkilendirir.

questions.question: What happens to local changes when an offline Firestore client reconnects in the described flow?

options.A: They require a manual database export/import
options.B: They are converted into source-code commits
options.C: They are always discarded on reconnect

questions.explanation: Aktif kullanılan veri cache'lenir; offline read/write/query mümkündür, yeniden bağlantıda yerel değişiklikler senkronize edilir.

questions.question: Which two capabilities are explicitly listed in Firestore's infrastructure features?

options.A: Transaction support

questions.explanation: Slayt atomic batch, transaction ve strong consistency ile otomatik replikasyonu sayar.

sets.title: Bigtable ingestion, processing and BigQuery distinction
sets.source: fundamentals/M4 _ Storage in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which workload best matches Bigtable in the course?

options.A: A small mobile dataset whose primary need is offline synchronization
options.B: A relational workload requiring multi-table joins
options.C: Large, rapidly changing NoSQL datasets needing high throughput and low latency
options.D: A strongly relational system needing multi-row transactions

questions.explanation: Bigtable büyük, hızlı ve çoğunlukla time-series/anahtar odaklı NoSQL veride hedeflenir; ilişkisel transaction ihtiyacı farklıdır.

questions.question: Which two processing modes are explicitly described for Bigtable data?

options.A: Only browser-based manual editing

questions.explanation: Kaynak stream için Dataflow/Spark Streaming/Storm, batch için Hadoop MapReduce/Dataflow/Spark örnekleri verir.

questions.question: Which framework is shown specifically among streaming examples?

options.A: Storm
options.C: Hadoop MapReduce as the streaming example

questions.explanation: Storm stream listesinde yer alır; diğer seçenekler Bigtable stream processing framework'ü olarak verilmez.

questions.question: Which interface is named in the API-based Bigtable access examples?

options.A: A SAML identity-provider endpoint

questions.explanation: HBase REST Server veya HBase client kullanan Java server veri servis katmanına örnektir.

questions.question: Why is BigQuery distinguished from Bigtable in the module?

options.A: BigQuery emphasizes analytics and interactive querying, beyond pure storage
options.B: BigQuery is simply a second name for Bigtable
options.C: Bigtable is only an object-archive service
options.D: BigQuery exists only to provide sub-millisecond per-key lookups

questions.explanation: İsim benzerliğine rağmen ürünler farklıdır; BigQuery veri işleme/analitik sorgulamaya odaklanır.

sets.title: Choosing among storage products
sets.source: fundamentals/M4 _ Storage in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: An application needs immutable binary objects such as photos and videos. Which product matches?

options.A: Firestore as binary-object hosting

questions.explanation: Blob ve medya nesneleri Cloud Storage kullanımına uyar; ilişkisel veya metric ürünü gerektirmez.

questions.question: An existing web application needs managed relational SQL support with familiar engines. Which product matches?

options.A: Cloud Storage

questions.explanation: Kaynak mevcut uygulama ve web framework'leri için Cloud SQL'i öne çıkarır.

questions.question: An OLTP workload requires relational SQL and horizontal scaling to very large capacity. Which product matches the comparison?

options.A: Cloud Storage
options.B: Cloud SQL without horizontal scale requirements

questions.explanation: Spanner ilişkisel OLTP ve yatay ölçeklemenin birleşimi olarak verilir; object storage veya DNS aynı işi yapmaz.

questions.question: A mobile app needs real-time results and offline query support. Which product matches?

options.A: Cloud Storage

questions.explanation: Firestore gerçek zamanlı senkronizasyon ve offline kullanım özellikleriyle eşleştirilir.

questions.question: The uploaded comparison table lists 1 MB as the maximum unit size for which product?

options.A: Firestore

questions.explanation: Tabloda Firestore entity için 1 MB, Cloud Storage object için 5 TB belirtilir; bu soru yüklenen tablo sürümüne bağlıdır.

sets.title: Container architecture and microservice scaling
sets.source: fundamentals/M5 _ Containers in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What does a container package in the module's definition?

options.A: Only source code without runtime dependencies
options.C: Only an instance template with no executable code
options.D: A complete independent guest operating system for every instance

questions.explanation: Container uygulama kodunu ve bağımlılıklarını sınırlandırılmış çalışma alanında taşır; fiziksel sunucu gerektiren paket değildir.

questions.question: Which two host components are identified as necessary to run containers?

options.A: An OS kernel that supports containers
options.B: A full separate guest OS per container
options.C: A dedicated physical machine for each container

questions.explanation: Container destekleyen kernel ve runtime host gereksinimleridir; her container ayrı guest OS taşımaz.

questions.question: Why can containers be created quickly in the course's explanation?

options.A: They boot a new guest OS for every process
options.B: They preallocate a full VM for each request
options.C: They require a complete disk-image migration first
options.D: Creation needs only a few system calls and starts like a process

questions.explanation: Container başlangıcı process'e benzer hafif işlemdir; tam VM/OS boot ile aynı değildir.

questions.question: Which action illustrates scaling the same containerized web application horizontally?

options.A: Rebuild the same single instance with a new image tag
options.B: Run additional instances of its container
options.C: Increase only the CPU of its single host
options.D: Rename the existing container without adding instances

questions.explanation: Container kopyaları artırılarak yük karşılanır; isim değiştirmek kapasite eklemez.

questions.question: Which two benefits are listed for an application composed of function-specific containers?

options.A: Every component must scale equally
options.B: Every change requires replacing all hosts together

questions.explanation: Mikroservis container'ları modüler olur ve bağımsız ölçeklenir; tüm bileşenlerin aynı şekilde büyümesi gerekmez.

sets.title: Pods, Deployments, Services and rollouts
sets.source: fundamentals/M5 _ Containers in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What is the smallest unit Kubernetes creates or deploys in this module?

options.A: A cluster

questions.explanation: Pod bir veya daha fazla container'ın birlikte çalışan en küçük dağıtım birimidir.

questions.question: When is placing multiple containers in one Pod particularly appropriate in the course?

options.A: When they need completely isolated networking
options.B: When they must reside on different nodes
options.C: When they have a hard dependency and should share networking/storage
options.D: When they are unrelated and must scale independently

questions.explanation: Sıkı bağımlı container'lar aynı Pod'da ağ/depolama paylaşabilir; ilgisiz uygulamaları bir araya getirmek amaç değildir.

questions.question: Which object manages replicas of a Pod and keeps them running despite node failures?

options.A: Deployment

questions.explanation: Deployment istenen replica grubunu yönetir; tekil Pod'ların yaşamından daha kalıcı bir desired-state tanımıdır.

questions.question: Which object provides a stable endpoint while Pod IP addresses change over time?

options.A: The container image's registry address

questions.explanation: Slayt 11 başlığı yanıltıcıdır; açıklama ve s.12 sabit endpoint'in Service'e ait olduğunu, Pod IP'lerinin değiştiğini belirtir.

questions.question: Which two operations match the module's command examples?

options.A: kubectl scale changes a Deployment's replica count
options.C: kubectl apply -f applies a configuration file
options.D: gcloud storage cp triggers a rolling update

questions.explanation: `scale` replica sayısını, `apply -f` deklaratif config'i uygular; rollout/config değişikliği yeni sürüme aşamalı geçişi destekler.

sets.title: Managed GKE, Autopilot and Standard
sets.source: fundamentals/M5 _ Containers in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What underlying resources form a GKE cluster in the module?

options.A: App Engine instances

questions.explanation: GKE cluster'ı Compute Engine makinelerinin gruplandırılmasıyla anlatılır.

questions.question: Which infrastructure component does GKE manage in both modes described?

options.A: Only the artifact registry

questions.explanation: GKE control plane provisioning ve yönetimini üstlenir; node sorumluluğu seçilen moda göre değişir.

questions.question: When does the course recommend choosing Standard rather than Autopilot?

options.A: Whenever any application uses containers
options.B: Whenever a Deployment has more than one replica
options.D: When specific infrastructure configuration control is required

questions.explanation: Autopilot varsayılan öneridir; Standard'ın özel altyapı kontrolü gerçekten gerekiyorsa seçilir.

questions.question: Which two cluster-management benefits are explicitly listed?

options.A: Automatic cluster-node-count scaling
options.C: Requiring customers to manage control-plane VMs

questions.explanation: GKE node sağlık/bakım ve node sayısı ölçekleme gibi özellikler sunar; uygulama hatalarını otomatik yok etmez.

questions.question: Which command in the module creates an Autopilot cluster?

options.A: gcloud container clusters create-auto k1 --region $CLUSTER_REGION

questions.explanation: `gcloud container clusters create-auto` cluster oluşturur; kubectl get services mevcut servisleri listeler.

sets.title: Cloud Run request handling and deployment workflows
sets.source: fundamentals/M6 _ Applications in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which two properties describe Cloud Run's primary service model in this module?

options.A: Remove infrastructure-management tasks from the developer
options.B: A restriction to one proprietary programming language
options.D: Mandatory customer management of every host VM

questions.explanation: Cloud Run stateless container'ları yönetilen altyapıda çalıştırır; dil seçimi container sözleşmesine bağlı olarak esnektir.

questions.question: Which open technology is named as the basis for the Cloud Run discussion?

options.A: HBase

questions.explanation: Kaynak Knative'ı Kubernetes üzerine kurulu açık API/runtime olarak adlandırır; tarihsel platform anlatımı güncel ürün adlarıyla karıştırılmamalıdır.

questions.question: What is the order of the container-based development workflow?

options.A: Create a VM, patch its OS, then skip container packaging
options.B: Build a database schema, export it, then configure DNS only
options.C: Write code, build/package an image, deploy to Cloud Run
options.D: Deploy code, write tests, then define any runtime

questions.explanation: Önce istek dinleyen uygulama, sonra image, son olarak deploy vardır; Artifact Registry image'ın saklandığı yer olarak gösterilir.

questions.question: What does the source-based workflow use to package an application?

options.A: Cloud Router

questions.explanation: Kaynak tabanlı akışta buildpacks image üretimini yapar; kullanıcı hazır image vermek zorunda değildir.

questions.question: Which compatibility requirement is stated for a binary in the container example?

options.A: Compiled for Linux 64-bit
options.B: Compiled only for Windows desktop execution
options.C: Compiled only for a browser's JavaScript engine

questions.explanation: PDF Linux 64-bit binary koşulunu belirtir; Java/Python gibi popüler ve daha az yaygın dillerin kullanılabileceğini anlatır.

sets.title: Cloud Run functions and event-driven applications
sets.source: fundamentals/M6 _ Applications in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which workload best matches Cloud Run functions in the module?

options.A: A non-event-driven physical network appliance
options.D: Resize an image when a new file is uploaded

questions.explanation: Görsel yükleme sonrası dönüştürme/thumbnail gibi tek amaçlı olay işleme function örneğidir.

questions.question: Which two services are listed as asynchronous event sources for functions?

options.A: Pub/Sub
options.C: Cloud Billing Reports as a listed source
options.D: Cloud DNS as a listed asynchronous event source

questions.explanation: Cloud Storage ve Pub/Sub olayları asenkron tetikleme örnekleridir.

questions.question: Which invocation method is explicitly associated with synchronous execution?

options.A: HTTP invocation
options.D: Only a Cloud Storage event trigger

questions.explanation: Slayt HTTP invocation'ı senkron, Storage/PubSub olaylarını asenkron örnekler olarak verir.

questions.question: What programming unit should a function generally implement according to the module?

options.A: A manually managed always-running server
options.B: A small, single-purpose piece of business logic
options.D: Every application component forced into one function

questions.explanation: Function küçük ve tek amaçlı iş mantığıyla servisleri bağlar/genişletir; her uygulamanın tümünü tek function yapmak gerekmez.

questions.question: Why use a managed function for a rare image-processing event?

options.A: Require a user to manually start a VM for each image
options.B: Disable event triggers and rely only on monthly batches
options.C: Run the event-driven code without provisioning a server or runtime environment yourself
options.D: Keep maximum VM capacity allocated permanently

questions.explanation: Kaynak nadir veya sık olayda compute altyapısını elle sağlamak yerine event geldiğinde çalışan yönetilen function yaklaşımını anlatır.

sets.title: Generative AI, LLMs and hallucination factors

questions.question: Which relationship between generative AI and LLMs is stated in the module?

options.A: LLMs and all generative AI are identical categories
options.B: Generative AI can generate text only
options.C: LLMs are a language-focused subset of the broader generative AI category
options.D: LLMs are only rule-based keyword lookup tables

questions.explanation: GenAI farklı içerik türlerini kapsayan geniş kategoridir; LLM dil odaklı alt kümedir.

questions.question: Which two quantities explain large in large language model?

options.A: The required number of GPUs per user
options.D: The length of every user prompt

questions.explanation: Large veri miktarı ve parametre sayısıdır; modelin kullanıcı arayüzündeki boyutu değildir.

questions.question: Which sequence matches the training approach described?

options.A: Pre-train on a large dataset, then fine-tune for a specific purpose
options.B: Fine-tune first, then discard the training data and weights
options.C: Manually define every possible response without training
options.D: Use only one zero-shot prompt to update all weights

questions.explanation: Pretraining genel örüntüleri öğrenir; fine-tuning daha belirli veri/görevle uyarlama yapar.

questions.question: Which three factors are explicitly listed as possible hallucination causes?

options.A: Insufficient context

questions.explanation: Slayt kirli/gürültülü veri, yetersiz eğitim verisi, bağlam ve kısıtları sayar; bir bucket'ın varlığı neden değildir.

questions.question: A polished answer contains an incorrect claim. Does fluent wording alone establish correctness?

options.A: Yes; the model automatically verifies every claim against private data
options.B: Yes; correct grammar guarantees factual accuracy
options.C: No; generated output can still be wrong or misleading
options.D: Yes; longer responses are always better grounded

questions.explanation: Halüsinasyon yanlış/yanıltıcı sonuç üretme riskidir. Akıcı anlatım doğruluk kanıtı değildir; s.13'teki eski mutlak model sınırlamaları kaynak notlarında ele alınır.

sets.title: Zero-shot, one-shot, few-shot and role prompts

questions.question: A prompt asks a question without providing any worked examples. What type does the course call it?

options.A: Fine-tuning

questions.explanation: Zero-shot örneksiz istektir; shot sayısı verilen örnek sayısıyla ilişkilidir.

questions.question: A prompt includes exactly one example before the new input. What type is it?

options.A: Role prompting alone

questions.explanation: One-shot tek örnek sağlar; yeni çözülmesi istenen input örnek sayısına eklenmez.

questions.question: How many examples does the course require at minimum for few-shot prompting?

options.A: Exactly ten

questions.explanation: Kaynak few-shot'ı en az iki örnek olarak açıklar; sabit yüz örnek koşulu yoktur.

questions.question: What is the function of role prompting in the course?

options.A: Guarantee factual correctness
options.C: Give the model a frame of reference for answering
options.D: Retrain all model weights for the role

questions.explanation: Role prompting bakış açısı/çerçeve sağlar. Prompt'ta rol atamak IAM yetkisi veya doğruluk garantisi değildir.

questions.question: Which two prompts contain worked examples rather than only an instruction or persona?

options.A: Italy: Rome. Japan: Tokyo. France: ___
options.B: Act as a geography teacher and answer my question.
options.C: What is the capital of France?

questions.explanation: İlk iki prompt örnek-çıktı çifti verir; yalnız soru zero-shot, yalnız persona role prompting unsurudur.

sets.title: Prompt preamble, input and iterative context

questions.question: Which two main prompt elements are named in the course?

options.A: Preamble

questions.explanation: Preamble görevi/bağlamı kurar; input görevin uygulanacağı asıl girdidir.

questions.question: Which material belongs naturally in the preamble?

options.A: Task instructions, context and optional examples
options.C: Only the unclassified item with no instructions

questions.explanation: Preamble talimat, bağlam ve örnekleri içerebilir; input bunların uygulanacağı metindir.

questions.question: In the sentiment-classification example, what is the input to classify?

options.A: The model's hidden parameters
options.B: Only the list of category names
options.C: All the previously labeled examples together

questions.explanation: Örnekte yeni yorum input'tur; önceki yorum/etiket çiftleri örnekler olarak preamble'dadır.

questions.question: How does Sasha make the network request more specific in the revised prompt?

options.A: Add the cloud-architect role and the need for IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack subnets
options.D: Replace the cloud role with an unrelated persona

questions.explanation: Rol ve dual-stack gereksinimi modelin yanıt odağını belirler; ayrıntı azaltmak bu amaca hizmet etmez.

questions.question: Why can Sasha ask how to adjust the previously provided gcloud command?

options.A: The command becomes an IAM policy automatically
options.B: No technical context is needed once any command was shown
options.C: The conversation retains interaction context in the example
options.D: Every follow-up retrains the model weights

questions.explanation: Kaynak konuşma bağlamının sürmesini örnekler; bu fine-tuning veya izin değişikliği değildir.

sets.title: Prompt engineering best practices and the Sasha example

questions.question: Which instruction is more explicit for summarizing meeting notes?

options.A: Request a paragraph, a speaker/key-points list and action items
options.B: Request any output format without identifying the task
options.C: Provide only a document title with no action
options.D: Ask only summarize this with no desired structure

questions.explanation: İstenen çıktı yapısı ve alt görevleri açıkça belirtmek belirsizliği azaltır.

questions.question: Which two boundary-setting practices are recommended in the movie-agent example?

options.A: Use only prohibitions without a positive task
options.B: Say what the model should do
options.C: Require invented answers when no suitable result exists
options.D: Provide an appropriate fallback when no recommendation is available

questions.explanation: Olumlu görev tarifi ve uygun fallback önerilir; modelin boşluğu uydurma içerikle doldurması istenmez.

questions.question: Why add a cloud-architect persona to a networking question?

options.A: Eliminate the need for network requirements
options.C: Guarantee production validation of the design

questions.explanation: Persona ilgili bakış açısını güçlendirir; doğruluk/üretim uygunluğu garantisi veya IAM grant değildir.

questions.question: How should long, complicated prompt sentences be improved according to the final best practice?

options.A: Combine all tasks into one very long sentence
options.B: Remove every constraint and technical detail
options.C: Break them into shorter sentences and simpler tasks
options.D: Repeat the same vague request unchanged

questions.explanation: Kısa cümleler ve daha basit görevler anlaşılabilirliği artırır; gerekli ayrıntılar korunur.

questions.question: Which architecture does Gemini propose in the final Sasha example in this document?

options.A: A single isolated subnet with no inter-VPC connections
options.B: A stand-alone public bucket with no network topology
options.D: A full mesh as the specific proposed example

questions.explanation: Sasha örneğinin yanıtı hub-and-spoke'tur. Bu, her gerçek ağ için tek doğru tasarım veya otomatik merkezi firewall garantisi değildir.

sets.title: Monoliths, SOA and the Enterprise Service Bus

questions.question: Which combination characterizes the traditional monolith described in the PDF?

options.A: Only independently deployable services with separate databases
options.B: A decentralized collection of unrelated APIs
options.C: Only an event router without business logic
options.D: UI, business logic and data access in one large application

questions.explanation: Monolit UI, iş mantığı ve veri erişimini tek büyük uygulamada toplar; sıkı bağımlılıklar bakım ve değişiklik riskini artırır.

questions.question: What should each service in the described SOA implement?

options.A: Every enterprise function in one component

questions.explanation: SOA yeniden kullanılabilir servislerle ayrı iş fonksiyonlarını modeller; kapsam genellikle işletme düzeyindedir.

questions.question: Which two responsibilities are attributed to the ESB?

options.A: Independent ownership of every service's business logic
options.D: Eliminating the need to test integrations

questions.explanation: ESB yönlendirme ve dönüşüm yapar; bağlantı/güvenlik yönetimi de anlatılır. Entegrasyon testine gerek kalmadığı sonucu çıkmaz.

questions.question: Why could ESB integration work delay multiple application teams?

options.A: Every service was guaranteed to deploy independently of integrations
options.C: A central team became a shared integration bottleneck

questions.explanation: Bütün ekiplerin merkezi ESB entegrasyonuna ihtiyaç duyması iş kuyruğu ve gecikme yaratabilir; karmaşıklık tamamen yok olmaz, ESB'ye taşınabilir.

questions.question: Which two risks of changing the ESB are explicitly discussed?

options.A: Every update automatically isolates all failures
options.B: Changing one integration may destabilize other applications
options.C: Updating ESB software may break existing integrations
options.D: All integration tests become unnecessary after the first release

questions.explanation: Paylaşılan entegrasyonlar ve ESB yazılım güncellemeleri başka uygulamaları etkileyebilir; bu yüzden kapsamlı test gerekir.

sets.title: Microservice boundaries and choosing a starting architecture

questions.question: Which two properties define microservices in the module?

options.A: Loose coupling
options.B: One mandatory central ESB controlling every change
options.D: One inseparable deployment unit for all business domains

questions.explanation: Mikroservisler sınırlı kapsamlı ve gevşek bağlı servislerdir; merkezi ESB veya tek dağıtım birimi zorunlu değildir.

questions.question: How are orders, products and reviews modeled in the decomposition example?

options.A: Only separate UI screens over unchanged tightly coupled code
options.B: A single shared data-access component used directly by all callers
options.C: A single service with three names
options.D: Separate services, each with its own database

questions.explanation: Şekil Orders, Products ve Reviews servislerini kendi veritabanlarıyla gösterir. Bu, bu örneğin sınırlandırma yaklaşımıdır.

questions.question: What do callers typically use to invoke a microservice's operations?

options.A: A shared copy of its in-memory objects
options.C: Direct access to all internal database tables

questions.explanation: Servisin dış arayüzü, genellikle API, çağrıyı tanımlar; iç kod/veritabanına bağlanmak kapsüllemeyi zayıflatır.

questions.question: Which three conditions support starting directly with microservices in the module?

options.A: Requiring all changes to ship as one inseparable release
options.C: Having no idea how to define service boundaries

questions.explanation: Alan bilgisi sınır tasarımını, agile delivery bağımsız sürümleri, büyüyen ekip ise küçük ekip sahipliğini destekler.

questions.question: A team does not yet understand its problem domain well. What starting approach does the module allow?

options.A: Build a modular monolith and separate services as understanding improves
options.B: Create arbitrary service boundaries immediately and never revise them
options.C: Require an enterprise ESB before any code can be written
options.D: Avoid modularity because future migration is impossible

questions.explanation: Doküman monolitle başlayıp deneyim arttıkça ayrıştırmayı kabul eder; başlangıçta modüler tasarım ileride taşımayı kolaylaştırır.

sets.title: Development, technology choice and independent scaling

questions.question: Which two advantages are linked to a smaller microservice codebase?

options.A: Easier unit testing with clear boundaries
options.B: A guarantee that interface changes cannot affect callers
options.C: Automatic elimination of distributed integration testing

questions.explanation: Küçük kod ve net sınırlar anlama/güncelleme ile unit test'i kolaylaştırır; sistemler arası test veya API uyumu sorununu yok etmez.

questions.question: When can updating one service affect other services despite independent deployment?

options.A: When a breaking change is made to its interface
options.B: Only when all services use the same database engine
options.C: Whenever its internal variable names change without interface changes
options.D: Whenever internal code is refactored while preserving API behavior

questions.explanation: Bağımsız deployment, breaking API değişikliğinin tüketicilere etkisini ortadan kaldırmaz. İç uygulama ayrıntıları arayüz korunursa gizlenebilir.

questions.question: Why can services use different programming languages and frameworks?

options.A: All services share the same language runtime in one process
options.B: The ESB requires identical technology stacks
options.C: Callers depend on API interfaces rather than internal implementation technology
options.D: Every caller must compile the callee's source code

questions.explanation: API sınırı dil/framework ayrıntısını tüketiciden ayırır; ekip hizmetine uygun teknoloji seçebilir.

questions.question: A Java orders service calls a Python product service hosted on another platform. Which principle permits this?

options.A: The caller must be rewritten in Python first
options.B: The two services must share one database driver
options.C: Both services must run in the same process

questions.explanation: Modül HTTP API'leriyle farklı platform ve dillerdeki servislerin iletişimini anlatır; aynı process veya dil gerekmez.

questions.question: Only the orders service experiences a traffic spike. What scaling approach matches the module?

options.A: Add capacity to orders independently and reduce it as traffic falls
options.B: Always merge orders and reviews into one deployment
options.C: Scale every service to the orders peak permanently
options.D: Keep every service at a fixed maximum allocation

questions.explanation: Servis bazlı kapasite, yalnız ihtiyaç duyulan yere kaynak ayırır; mevcut trafiğe göre ölçekleme maliyeti optimize edebilir.

sets.title: Operational burden, network latency, testing and debugging

questions.question: Which two challenges follow from having many deployable services?

options.A: Greater operational skill requirements
options.C: More deployments and potential failure points

questions.explanation: Servis başına kod basitleşse de dağıtılan birim sayısı ve operasyon yükü artar; ortak güvenlik/raporlama tutarlılığı gerekir.

questions.question: Which three activities does the PDF identify as crucial to automate?

options.A: Every API change without compatibility checks

questions.explanation: Build, test ve deployment otomasyonu çok sayıda servisin sağlığını/verimliliğini yönetmek için önemlidir.

questions.question: Why can an operation involving many microservice calls gain significant latency?

options.A: Network communication is always faster than local calls
options.B: Microservices eliminate the need to transfer data
options.C: Network calls replace many in-process calls
options.D: Every API call necessarily removes all serialization overhead

questions.explanation: Monolitteki aynı-process çağrılar ağ çağrılarına dönüşebilir; çok adımda bu gecikmeler birikir.

questions.question: Why can integration tests be harder even when individual unit tests are simpler?

options.A: Testing the whole system may require modeling the distributed production deployment
options.B: Only the largest service needs to be tested
options.C: Integration testing is unnecessary if services use APIs
options.D: Unit tests automatically prove all network interactions correct

questions.explanation: Unit test sınır içini, integration test servisler arası bütünü ölçer; dağıtık ortamın modellenmesi ek zorluk getirir.

questions.question: Why is debugging a request that crosses many services challenging?

options.A: All services necessarily use the same process stack
options.B: Independent deployment prevents any distributed failures
options.C: Separate logs automatically create a complete end-to-end trace
options.D: Each service may produce separate logs, making the full call path hard to trace

questions.explanation: Dağınık loglar uçtan uca çağrı takibini zorlaştırır; tutarlı logging/reporting ve operasyonel disiplin önem kazanır.

sets.title: Cloud Tasks: delivery, scheduling, destinations and identity

questions.question: Which two Cloud Tasks features were accepted in your submitted quiz?

options.A: The task creator has no control over its destination
options.B: Exactly-once execution of every handler is guaranteed
options.C: Scheduling a task for future delivery

questions.explanation: Paylaşılan quizde kabul edilen ikili at-least-once delivery ve geleceğe zamanlamadır. Exactly-once sonucu çıkarılamaz.

questions.question: A task might be executed more than once. Which handler property avoids duplicate side effects?

options.A: Assuming every delivery is unique
options.C: Generating a new irreversible charge for every retry

questions.explanation: Tekrarlı yürütme olasılığı nedeniyle handler idempotent tasarlanır; aynı işi yeniden almak zararlı sonucu tekrar üretmemelidir.

questions.question: Using CreateTask for an HTTP task, what does the creator specify?

options.A: Only a topic, with no control over the handler
options.B: The service and handler that should process it
options.C: Only a workflow's current execution state
options.D: Only an event schema, with no destination

questions.explanation: CreateTask akışında hedef servis/handler belirtilir. Task'ı üretenin hedef üzerinde kontrolü yok ifadesi bu modele uymaz.

questions.question: What does a future scheduling time allow?

options.A: Remove all possible retries
options.C: Defer delivery until a later scheduled time
options.D: Convert a task into a broadcast to every service

questions.explanation: Geleceğe zamanlama ne zaman gönderileceğini düzenler; duplicate, retry veya fan-out için tek başına garanti değildir.

questions.question: Which identity distinction is accurate for authenticated HTTP tasks?

options.A: Cloud Tasks cannot attach authentication tokens to HTTP requests
options.B: The configured service-account identity used for the token is distinct from the Cloud Tasks service agent's role in creating tokens
options.C: The service agent's identity must always be the target-caller identity
options.D: Adding a token automatically grants every target permission

questions.explanation: Token yapılandırmasındaki hesap ile platformun service agent rolünü ayır. Kimlikli HTTP çağrısı desteklenir; gerekli IAM izinleri ayrıca gerekir.

sets.title: Choreography versus orchestration

questions.question: Which two choreography benefits were accepted in your quiz?

options.A: Loosely coupled services
options.C: The producer maintains full control over every downstream step
options.D: The entire business process is always easy to understand

questions.explanation: Quiz choreography için gevşek bağlılık ve merkezi olmayan yönetimi kabul eder; üretici bütün sonraki adımları yönetmez.

questions.question: A producer publishes an event and independent services react. Where does control primarily reside in choreography?

options.A: Only in a mandatory central orchestrator
options.D: In a single producer that invokes every downstream operation

questions.explanation: Paylaşılan açıklama yönetimin servis düzeyinde olduğunu belirtir. Merkezî tüm-adım yönetimi orchestration tarafındaki ayrımdır.

questions.question: Why is full producer control over downstream operations not a choreography benefit?

options.A: All consumers must run in the producer's process
options.B: Independent consumers determine their reactions to events
options.C: No consumer is allowed to react without a central workflow definition
options.D: Every event must contain all consumers' private code

questions.explanation: Gevşek bağlı tüketiciler kendi tepkilerini yönetir; üreticinin bütün downstream akışı kontrol etmesi choreography'nin avantajı değildir.

questions.question: Which claim should not be inferred from decentralized control?

options.A: Control can live at service level
options.B: The complete business process is always easy to follow

questions.explanation: Quiz business logic'in kolay anlaşılmasını kabul edilen faydalar arasına koymaz. Dağıtık kontrol bütünü gözlemlemeyi zorlaştırabilir.

questions.question: A team wants a centrally defined sequence coordinating several services. Which pattern best matches?

options.A: A single local retry loop with no process definition
options.B: Pure decentralized choreography with no coordinator
options.C: Independent event reactions without shared sequencing

questions.explanation: Workflows merkezî tanımlı adım akışını koordine eden orchestration örneğidir; bağımsız tepkilerle aynı kontrol modeli değildir.

sets.title: Workflows: execution state and long-running coordination

questions.question: Which two Workflows features were accepted in your quiz?

options.A: A decentralized view with no central workflow definition
options.C: Only simple business processes are appropriate

questions.question: A business process includes waits and retries across several services. Which product most directly coordinates the process?

options.A: Cloud Storage used only to retain objects
options.C: Cloud Tasks used only to deliver one HTTP task

questions.explanation: Workflows adımları ve bekleme/retry durumunu koordine eder; tek task teslimi uçtan uca süreç koordinasyonu değildir.

questions.question: A team needs to inspect a workflow run's current or final step. Which feature addresses this need?

options.C: Only an event's arbitrary payload format

questions.explanation: Execution sonuçları/durumu belirli çalışmanın mevcut veya son adımını incelemeyi sağlar.

questions.question: What does observing a workflow execution let you distinguish?

sets.title: Eventarc Standard: CloudEvents, Audit Logs and Pub/Sub

questions.question: Which event-format statement corrects the mistake in your submitted quiz?

questions.question: Which two statements form the expected correct pair for your Eventarc question in its Standard context?

questions.question: An Audit Logs entry is written. Under what condition does the described Eventarc trigger route it?

questions.explanation: Audit Logs tabanlı trigger eşleşen kayıtları route eder; bütün logları koşulsuz bütün hedeflere dağıtmaz.

questions.question: For a Cloud Run event receiver, which interaction matches Eventarc delivery?

options.D: Eventarc routes matching events to the configured receiver

questions.explanation: Cloud Run alıcısına olay teslim edilir. Quizdeki uygulamanın kuyruğu izlemesi ifadesi bu delivery modelinin açıklaması değildir.

questions.question: Which pairing correctly separates event representation from transport in this course context?

options.A: Cloud Audit Logs: transport for all events; CloudEvents: destination identity
options.B: CloudEvents: database engine; Pub/Sub: authentication token

questions.explanation: Sınav için temel ayrım format=CloudEvents, taşıma=Pub/Sub'tır; Audit Logs olay kaynağı olabilir. Pub/Sub ifadesi burada Eventarc Standard kapsamındadır.
